independence.note: CHEMICAL evidence is independent of ALL textual traditions. GREEK and CHINESE traditions are independent before ~150 CE. INDIAN traditions may have transmitted to both Greek and Chinese.

convergence_monte_carlo.interpretation: 9/9 traditions independently converge on insular SE Asia. Under random assignment to 8 regions, probability of >= 9 converging on same region: p=0.0000

gap_analysis.reason_expected: Tamil maritime traders were major Indian Ocean actors
